meaning:
ἀνα-δέχομαι
[in LXX: 2Ma.6:19 2Mac 8:36 * ;]
1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, Heb.11:17.
2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, Act.28:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us, and courteously entertained us for…
By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son,
